description.en: A collapsible Conversation Tree band beside the conversation: organises DSH sessions by workspace, topic, and conversation, opens the real sessions in place, and exposes the tree to the assistant through 9 model tools.
description.zh: 会话列旁的可折叠「对话树」栏：把 DSH 会话按工作区、主题、对话组织，就地打开真实会话，并通过 9 个模型工具让助手读写这棵树。
